body:
Real, new PARENA module mirroring stdlib/mixforge/mixer.prn's own quarter-cos equal-power curve construction (no cross-import, same 'each module stands alone' precedent). Compiled to wasm via the same parena->LLVM->wasm32->wasm-ld pipeline MIXFORGE established. 14/14 kernel checks verified live in IDUNA/frontend/nock/scripts/nle_test.mjs. Found and fixed a real, live, unrelated bug along the way: the checked-out ./parena binary predated a same-day emit_llvm.c fix mixer.prn/sampler.prn themselves needed. Commit a6c91fd.

⚓ ☃
title: New stdlib/video/nle.prn: crossfade/fade/pad-capture DSP for NOCK's MIXFORGE EDITOR
